Na__AppData__FormatRegistry__.description: Single source of truth for every file extension the application recognises, which loader route handles it, and whether that route can produce geometry. The FileIngest router reads this; nothing else hard-codes an extension list.

routeNotes.ifc: web-ifc WASM. Real BIM route - carries declared units, GUIDs, property sets and spatial structure.
routeNotes.occt: occt-import-js WASM (OpenCascade). True BREP solids tessellated on load at a controllable linear deflection.
routeNotes.three: Stock three.js addon loaders. Mesh formats only - no reliable unit declaration in most of them.
routeNotes.revitAudit: In-house OLE2/CFBF reader. Metadata only. Autodesk RFA/RVT geometry is proprietary and cannot be extracted by any open-source library.

unitPolicy.rationale: UK architectural practice works in millimetres and the source BIM content declares millimetres. Every loader converts to mm exactly once, records the factor it applied, and the viewer never rescales again.
unitPolicy.glbRationale: The glTF 2.0 specification fixes linear distance units at metres. Export applies a single mm to m conversion and then verifies the written file measures the same as the source.

formats.label: IFC - Industry Foundation Classes
formats.notes: IFC2x3, IFC4 and IFC4x3 all supported. Unit factor is read from IFCUNITASSIGNMENT, never assumed.

formats.label: IFC XML
formats.notes: Handled by the same engine. Rare in practice.

formats.label: STEP - ISO 10303 AP203/AP214/AP242
formats.notes: Manufacturer part downloads are usually STEP. OpenCascade reads the declared unit from the file header.

formats.label: IGES
formats.notes: Older surface exchange format. Frequently produces open shells - the audit panel will flag them.

formats.label: OpenCascade BREP
formats.notes: Unitless native OpenCascade format. Assumed millimetres; the user must confirm.

formats.label: glTF 2.0 / GLB
formats.notes: Specification fixes units at metres, so the assumption is safe and is applied as a 1000x conversion into mm.

formats.label: Wavefront OBJ
formats.notes: No unit declaration exists in the format. The unit override control must be used if the guess is wrong.

formats.label: STL - Stereolithography
formats.notes: No units, no materials, no shared vertices. Almost always millimetres in practice.

formats.label: Autodesk 3DS
formats.notes: Legacy format with a hard 16-bit vertex limit per mesh. Large models arrive pre-split.

formats.label: COLLADA
formats.notes: Declares a unit scale in its asset block, which the loader honours.

formats.label: Autodesk FBX
formats.notes: FBX defaults to centimetres. The loader reads the UnitScaleFactor header where present.

formats.label: Revit Family
formats.notes: Audit only. Reads the PartAtom parameter schedule, BasicFileInfo and the embedded preview thumbnail. Geometry requires conversion to IFC first.

formats.label: Revit Project
formats.notes: Audit only. Project files rarely carry a PartAtom stream, so usually only version info and the preview are recoverable.

formats.label: Revit Template
formats.notes: Audit only. Same container format as RFA/RVT.

revitConversionRoute.summary: Autodesk RFA and RVT geometry is not readable by any open-source library. Convert to IFC first, then load the IFC here.
revitConversionRoute.converterNote: Runs without Revit installed. Confirmed to produce IFC4 Reference View V1.2 in millimetres. Handles .rvt project files; .rfa family files may need opening in Revit and exporting, as the converter targets project documents.
